notes.name: Use the project name from the signed scope.
notes.measurer: script reads {probes: {name: value}}. For pairs, the owner or people they name pick blind pairs. Write {pairs: {champion: {won, lost, tied}, start: {won, lost, tied}}}. Each tie counts as half a win.
notes.weights: Set probe weights to sum to 1 for the weighted geometric mean. Weight 0 protects a probe from regressions without scoring it.
notes.lower_is_better: List probes such as elapsed time whose ratio improves when the number falls.
notes.repeats: Measure the unchanged target this many times to estimate noise, counting the baseline.
notes.min_gain: Use twice the measured score spread by default, or enter a fraction such as 0.05 for five percent.
notes.max_drop: Use twice each probe's measured spread by default. A larger drop turns a gain into a trade.
notes.confirm_below: A KEEP below this multiple of min_gain needs a second KEEP for the same change.
notes.quality_share_max: A quality check above this fraction of pass time needs a cheaper equivalent or an owner decision.
notes.score_share_min: Below this share of time measuring the score, improve the loop before the next idea.
notes.category_switch_after: After this many passes in one category without a KEEP, profile again and change category.
notes.bold_every: Include a code or design change within this many passes. TEXT covers a change to the content itself.
notes.invariants: When true, write runs/NNNN/invariants.json with ok and problems before measuring. False means the project has no invariant checks.
notes.locked: List the scorer files relative to the project. The lock hashes them and climb.py, and keeps the step commands, so edits are visible.

heldout.mode: off skips the check, advisory reports its answer, required asks for a PASS.
heldout.share: This fraction of the visible gain must repeat on private inputs.
heldout.dir: Keep check.py, its private inputs and its answers in this folder.

notes.cost_per_hour: Measured pass time times this hourly price gives the cost in USD. Zero covers free compute.
notes.machine: Use the compute label from the scope so each results row identifies the measurement setup.

steps.start: Apply CLIMB_CHANGE and start the target. Each command runs in the project folder. An empty command skips its step.
steps.warmup: Bring the champion and candidate to the same state before scoring.
steps.score: Write score.json in CLIMB_OUT with probes or blind pair counts.
steps.quality: Write quality.json in CLIMB_OUT with ok (true or false) and fails (reasons).
steps.stop: Clean up the target after every pass, including a failure or timeout. End everything start began: a background process of a finished step runs until stop ends it.

budget.step_seconds: A positive cap kills a stalled command and its children. Cleanup and held-out checks each get their own step cap.
budget.pass_seconds: A positive cap limits the total time before cleanup, even when each step stays under its own cap. The stop step then gets one more step cap.
budget.run_hours: Optional time limit from the first recorded pass. With null, the owner stops the loop with STOP.
